architecture.mechanism: Coordinated renewable integration with load management strategies to mitigate power quality issues and improve voltage stability.
architecture.intervention: Implement a vehicle-side battery management system update that applies selective disconnection and coordinated charging logic during grid instability to prevent parasitic drain and ensure stable voltage supply to the 12V auxiliary battery.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of battery drain and no-start conditions by stabilizing the charging voltage and preventing deep discharge cycles caused by grid harmonics or fluctuation.
architecture.falsification_test: Monitor vehicle battery voltage and state-of-charge over a 72-hour period while subjecting the charging input to simulated harmonic distortion; failure is confirmed if voltage drops below 12.4V or if the ERC code reappears.
